text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was able to show the results of my 
training too. I got closer to my ideal 
running style...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I can't be satisfied with just 
this. I need to be more, much more...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-If you're here, say something! Watching 
me in silence like that is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You scared me! I guess I was so 
excited that I didn't even notice you were 
there."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey... what did you think... of my 
run today?
choice_data_list: I got to see you give it your all.

I felt there's still plenty of room for 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey... what did you think... of my 
run today?
choice_data_list: I got to see you give it your all.

I felt there's still plenty of room for 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really? It felt good to me, but hearing 
you say it out loud... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Let's keep this momentum going 
for the next race too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you have high hopes for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine... Because I want to aim even 
higher too...!
